tools.name: list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: Lists issues in a project, newest first. Use it to find an issue's id before reading or changing it. Returns id, title, state and version for each.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.title: Get an issue
tools.description: Returns one issue with all its fields and its current version. Use it before update_issue so the update carries the version you read.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.title: Create an issue
tools.description: Creates a new issue in a project and returns its id.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.title: Delete an issue
tools.description: Deletes an issue permanently, with its comments and attachments.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to an issue and notifies its watchers by email.

tools.name: close_issue
tools.title: Close an issue
tools.description: Closes an open issue. Calling it again on a closed issue changes nothing, so it is safe to retry.

tools.name: api_request
tools.title: Raw API request
tools.description: Makes a request to the API.
